#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>

using namespace std;

pair<int, int> documentAnalyser(const string& doc) {
    bool insideParenthesis = false;
    bool lastWasLetter = false;
    
    int longestLength = 0;
    int wordLength = 0;
    
    int wordsInParentheses = 0;
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < doc.length(); ++i) {
        if (doc[i] == '(') {
            insideParenthesis = true;
            lastWasLetter = false;
            wordLength = 0;
        }
        else if (doc[i] == ')') {
            insideParenthesis = false;
            lastWasLetter = false;
            wordLength = 0;
        }
        else if (isalpha(doc[i])) {
            if (insideParenthesis && !lastWasLetter) {
                wordsInParentheses += 1;
            }
            else if (!insideParenthesis) {
                wordLength += 1;
                longestLength = max(wordLength, longestLength);
            }
            lastWasLetter = true;
        }
        else {
            lastWasLetter = false;
            wordLength = 0;
        }
    }
    return make_pair(longestLength, wordsInParentheses);
}

int main() {
    int stringLength;
    cin >> stringLength;
    string doc;
    cin >> doc;
    pair<int, int> analysis = documentAnalyser(doc);
    cout << analysis.first << " " << analysis.second << endl;
    return 0;
}
